summary: Plan a file-only Discord notification smoke test; live delivery cannot be verified without Discord/network access.
scope: Inspect repository notification configuration and scripts.
Identify a safe local dry-run or fixture-based smoke-test path.
Validate message payload structure and expected success logging using built-in file tooling only.
out_of_scope: Accessing Discord webhooks, APIs, or external services.

acceptance_criteria.description: Discord notification configuration or implementation path is identified from repository files.
A local, non-network smoke-test mechanism or its absence is documented.

required_validations: Read-only inspection of notification-related configuration and scripts.
Run only repository-local, non-network validation if an existing safe command is available.
